call_points.text: EBITDA margin expanded 70 bps QoQ to 21.9% due to operational leverage and lower one-offs.
Transportation grew 2% QoQ in CC, led by US and India, while Europe remained soft.
Healthcare and life sciences grew 3.5% QoQ in CC following new deal wins like Terumo.
Employee utilization rose to 78%, with further headroom anticipated.
FY27 growth aspiration stays at high-single-digit; management said it is not changing its aspirations.
EBIT margin fell 330 bps QoQ and rose 80 bps YoY; about 150 bps was one-off costs.
A company-wide wage revision in Q2FY27 will partly offset the one-off costs going away.
Media & communication grew 11.5% YoY in constant currency on ramp-up of deals closed in previous quarters.
Healthcare was flat QoQ in constant currency at -0.3%, with delayed deal awards from key customers.
Utilisation was 74.7%, just below 75%, leaving room before fresh hiring.
Attrition is around 16%; the company is retaining key AI-ready talent amid GCC competition.
Europe, especially Germany, remains a wait-and-watch market for automotive; US and APAC are growing.
AI budgets are partly crowding out discretionary R&D spend, though management sees it as budget reallocation, not deferment.
Management expects higher single-digit growth for FY27 rather than double-digit due to global uncertainties.
EBITDA margin improved by 130 bps QoQ to 24.6%, aided by currency tailwinds and operating leverage.
Healthcare and Life Sciences de-grew 13.1% QoQ in CC due to expected deal award delays.
Media and Communication revenue grew 5.6% QoQ in CC, led by ramp-ups and strategic deal wins.

operating_notes.text: Company has zero subsidiaries, associates, or joint ventures as on March 31, 2026.
Established strategic partnership with JSW Motors to set up JNEXT R&D Center in Pune for connected and software-defined vehicle solutions.
OEM customers represent 77% of revenue in the transportation vertical.
Launched ViTel, a material intelligence solution for Med-Tech powered by Viridium AI, co-developed through the STEP UP program.

Launched AnaTel, an AI-native software development platform for healthcare and medtech co-developed with OpenAna through the STEP.UP co-innovation programme; filing claims it can cut SaMD development timelines from eight weeks to 72 hours.
Renewable energy consumption reached 66.58% in FY25-26.
Renewable energy consumption reached 66.25% in FY25-26.
Transportation contributes more than 55% of SDS segment revenue, and 78% of automotive revenue comes from OEM customers.
Europe is the largest automotive geography at slightly more than 40% of revenue, with the US at roughly 25-30% and the rest from APAC.
Utilisation was 74.7% and attrition around 16% in Q1FY27.
Q2FY27: software development & services was ₹1,027.87 Cr of ₹1,055.66 Cr total revenue; system integration was ₹27.79 Cr.
Q2FY27: unbilled receivables were ₹233.62 Cr against billed receivables of ₹837.55 Cr, with unbilled up from ₹189.71 Cr at March 31, 2026.
H1FY27: dividend paid ₹467.23 Cr and cash from operations ₹373.85 Cr; cash and equivalents ₹162.03 Cr at September 30, 2026.
Q2FY27 broad-based growth driven by Transportation (+2.0% QoQ cc), Media & Communications (+3.4% QoQ cc), and Healthcare & Life Sciences (+3.5% QoQ cc).
Employee utilization stood at 78% in Q2FY27.

timeline.summary: Tata Elxsi reported Q4FY26 operating revenue of ₹993.8 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹75 per share.
Tata Elxsi Limited shared the audio recording link for its conference call on audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26, held April 21, 2026.
Tata Elxsi formed a strategic partnership with JSW Motors to establish the JNEXT R&D Center in Pune for connected and software-defined vehicles.
Tata Elxsi held its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on April 21, 2026, reporting ₹993.8 Cr operating revenue.
On May 26, 2026, Tata Elxsi launched ViTel, an AI-powered material intelligence solution for Med-Tech co-developed with Viridium AI.
On May 27, 2026, Tata Elxsi launched AnaTel, an AI-native software development platform for healthcare and medtech co-developed with OpenAna through its STEP.UP programme.
Tata Elxsi filed its FY26 Integrated Annual Report reporting standalone revenue of ₹3,757.4 Cr and convening its 37th AGM for June 24, 2026.
On June 1, 2026, Tata Elxsi filed its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY 2025-26 with third-party reasonable assurance.

Tata Elxsi reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹1,021.1 Cr, up 6.5% YoY in constant currency, with EBITDA of ₹216 Cr and a 21.2% margin, and held its high-single-digit FY27 growth aspiration on the July 14, 2026 call.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,055.66 Cr (+15.0% YoY), net profit ₹170.3 Cr (+10.0% YoY).
On October 13, 2026, Tata Elxsi approved the appointment of Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP as statutory auditor for a five-year term starting from the 2027 AGM.
Tata Elxsi reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,055.7 Cr (+15% YoY) with EBITDA margin expanding to 21.9%.
Tata Elxsi’s **SNEHA VIJAYAKUMAR** shared the audio recording link for the **Q2 & H1FY27 (ended Sep 30, 2026) results conference call**, held October 13, 2026.
Tata Elxsi reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,055.7 Cr, up 2.3% YoY in constant currency, with an EBITDA of ₹231.4 Cr and a margin of 21.9%, maintaining its high-single-digit growth aspiration.
